name: FakePlayer-PNX

versions.changelog:
## What's Changed

Migrated FakePlayer-PNX to the PowerNukkitX 3.0.0 API and the new Cloudburst API.

- Updated all core classes (`FakePlayerHandler`, `FakePlayerEntity`, `FakeBedrockPeer`, `FakeBedrockSession`, behaviours, listeners, commands) for compatibility with PNX 3.0.0
- Bumped `api` compatibility in `plugin.yml` to `3.0.0`

Huge thanks to @ValresMC for contributing this migration via #1!

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/YnXahgkiO/FakePlayer-PNX/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1
